_comment: The demo input. Two users, two agents, incompatible auth assumptions. r1/r4 are the collision: 'no external services + server-side revocation' cannot coexist with 'stateless JWT'. Neither agent may concede a must-have without a human override.
feature: Add user authentication to the notes API so each user only sees their own notes.

requirements.text: No external services. Everything runs on our own box, no Auth0, no Firebase, no hosted identity provider.
A logged-out user must be logged out immediately. Revoking a session has to take effect on the very next request.
Keep the existing pytest suite green. Do not rewrite the test harness.
Auth must be stateless. Any API node can verify a request without a shared session store, so we can scale horizontally later.
The mobile client cannot use cookies. The token has to travel in an Authorization header.
Auth check should add under 5ms per request.
